_comment: UCP Platform Profile for Fit Check.
Host this at a stable HTTPS URL and set UCP_PLATFORM_PROFILE_URL to it.
Per spec: ucp.version, ucp.services and ucp.payment_handlers are REQUIRED and
must be present even when empty.
VERSIONS: negotiation intersects by name AND version; a capability with no
mutual version is silently excluded. Kith advertises 2026-04-08 only, so that
is the one that matters today. Older versions stay listed for stores that
haven't moved. Run probe.ts and add any version reported as advertised but
SCHEMA URLS: confirmed against Kith's live manifest 2026-08-26 — these paths
are what real Shopify stores advertise, not guesses.
dev.shopify.catalog: Shopify's catalog extension, which adds filters and
variant fields on top of the base capabilities. Declared here because leaving
it out means negotiation excludes it and those fields never arrive. Spec and
schema copied verbatim from Kith's manifest.
